data.name: Amail
data.gender_notes: Amail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-M-L’ which means 'to trust' or 'to place trust in'. This name signifies someone who is trustworthy, dependable, and reliable, both in their personal and professional relationships. The name Amail carries the meaning “Trustworthy, Dependable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amail usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, dependable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of trust and faith in Allah.
data.etymology: Amail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, Dependable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amail total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) mentioned many times that protecting trust is a duty that every Muslim must undertake. The name 'Amail' bears this Islamic value by representing one who is trustworthy and reliable.
